description.en: The ID of the image cache.
The name of the image cache.

description.zh:
是否完全匹配容器镜像。    
在配置了MatchImage取值的情况下，进一步过滤查询结果。
description.en:
Specifies whether to perform an exact match for the container images.
This parameter is used to further filter the query results when \`MatchImage\` is specified.

description.zh:
完全匹配容器镜像的镜像缓存个数。    
在配置了MatchImage取值的情况下，进一步过滤查询结果。
description.en:
The number of image caches that exactly match the container images.
This parameter is used to further filter the query results when \`MatchImage\` is specified.
The maximum number of entries to return.

description.zh: 指定容器镜像，用于查询最佳匹配的镜像缓存，最多100个。
description.en: The container images that are used to query the matched image caches. You can specify up to 100 images.

description.zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值。
description.en: The token that is used for the next query. You can obtain the token from the \`NextToken\` parameter in the response to the previous API call.
The ID of the resource group to which the image cache belongs.
The ID of the snapshot that corresponds to the image cache.

description.zh: 镜像缓存绑定的标签信息。
description.en: The tags that are attached to the image cache.

title.zh: 批量查询镜像缓存信息
